propositions: Rebar must safely delegate authentication to upstream SDKs and helpers (Git, SSH agents, AWS credential chains, boto3, Anthropic, OpenAI) rather than implementing a universal secret broker or credential store.

Provider-native capabilities (Anthropic AccessTokenProvider, OpenAI workload identity, boto3 Session) are injected into Rebar-owned factories; unavoidable static credentials use Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes only in provider-specific non-serializable containers, excluded from snapshots and caches.

Current defect: _bridge_runner copies full parent environment to reconciler child and ticket delivery, exposing unrelated provider credentials; RP-04 must replace this with adapter-owned baseline and operation-scoped credential overlay only for owning adapters.

Static credential rotation in long-running processes is restart/redeploy based; short-lived CLI processes receive startup environment; Rebar does not poll environment, watch files, or refresh SSM mid-process.

Trusted same-capability subprocesses inherit ambient environment for compatibility; Rebar materializes static credentials only onto owning child; unrelated sibling children remove exact declared secret variable names but preserve unknown ambient and native credential-process chains.

Application-owned secrets (Langfuse OTLP, opcert signing keys, MCP proxy tokens, review-bot webhook tokens) must be classified as provider-owned, deployment-owned static adapter input, or Rebar-owned security material before ADR prose; ADR 0049 per-job SSM fetch with externally managed replacement visibility replaces process-global key-path/principal/sync-push handoff with context-local typed runtime binding.
